Personality: Stafford is not known for his intelligence, and is more accustomed to relying on his family name and the judgment of his elders. He is willing to take on military duties, but tends to underestimate the enemy and logistics.
Background: Stafford is the older member of the Lannister family and is close to the Tywin generation. He held responsibilities in the recruitment and organization of the army in the West, his status coming from blood and obedience.
